run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run; used as folder name under runs/.

dataset_root.description: Path to dataset root directory containing metadata/, sketches/, and the reference HTML.

index_path.description: Optional path to a JSONL index file; each line should be an object with an 'id' field.

ids.description: Optional explicit list of sample IDs to run. If provided, overrides index_path and dataset discovery.

provider.description: Provider backend to use. 'hf' loads the model directly via transformers and runs inference in-process (see HF_* env vars in providers/hf_provider.py). 'modal' targets an OpenAI-compatible endpoint deployed on modal.com (see MODAL_* env vars in providers/modal_provider.py). 'fake' is reserved for local smoke tests.

prompt_template.description: Prompt template identifier (a .j2 file in src/responsive/prompts/templates), e.g. 'generate_a11y'.

mode.description: Run mode: 'generate_a11y' (benchmark generation from the paired sketches), 'augment_from_sketch' (two-stage sketch analysis then reference HTML augmentation), 'augment_from_screenshot' (augment the reference HTML from its desktop/tablet/mobile screenshots), 'reconstruct_from_screenshot' (reconstruct HTML from screenshots only). Augmenting modes write to dataset/<dataset_output_dir>/.

concurrency.description: Number of samples generated in parallel via a thread pool. Set to 1 to run strictly sequentially (e.g. a single-instance local vLLM server that can't handle concurrent requests).

overwrite.description: If false, samples with existing output are skipped: output.html for generate_a11y, or dataset/<dataset_output_dir>/<id>.html for augmenting modes.

retry.description: Retry configuration for handling transient errors.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (including initial attempt).

initial_backoff_seconds.description: Initial backoff delay in seconds before first retry.

max_backoff_seconds.description: Maximum backoff delay in seconds (caps exponential backoff).

backoff_multiplier.description: Multiplier for exponential backoff (e.g., 2.0 means double each retry).

seed.description: Optional integer seed used only for deterministic naming and hashing; not guaranteed to affect provider randomness.

created_by.description: Optional free-form string for bookkeeping (e.g., username, machine).

dataset_output_dir.description: Dataset output subdirectory name for augmenting modes (augment_from_sketch, augment_from_screenshot, reconstruct_from_screenshot). Overrides the mode default. Example: "augmented_gpt4o" writes to dataset/augmented_gpt4o/.

level.description: Log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

file_path.description: Custom log file path (relative to run directory). If null, defaults to run.log.
